plan.strategy: CPU near/mid distance and conservative per-instance frustum selection. Bounded cache of immutable compacted MultiMeshes avoids reassigned-slot motion history; original far and shadows remain.
plan.followup_budget: At most one additional baseline/candidate return pair if comparison drift is unresolved. One replacement per failed operation, preserve rejected.
plan.acceptance: GPU and rendered FPS or tail improvement beyond matched observed variation, baseline return gates 3% mean frame/GPU and15% p95/p99. Preserve visuals/identity. If rejected restore candidate runtime and retain blocked evidence.
plan.profiles: Separate native GPU profiles and 120-cap confirmations only after local pilot justifies production comparison.

acceptance_limits: Reject after dense pilot and source-identical return. Open/mineral/stress/counterbalanced candidate return and capped production comparisons were not run.
Three native local stills per source; inspected matching detail and overview plus candidate riding. No full dense chronological FSR/motion/wind/contact/canopy/weather acceptance matrix.
Packed transform/history and conservative selector fixtures do not establish visible motion quality or human/controller acceptance.
uploaded_bytes counts CPU API payload once; it is not measured bus bandwidth. New temporal buffers initialize two GPU halves.
Cached transform bytes exclude resource overhead and doubled temporal buffers. Video bytes are allocator telemetry, not physical VRAM residency.
No native per-family vertex/pixel attribution or synchronized GPU clocks/queue/residency analysis. GPU pass differences are observations, not proof of their underlying cause.
No completed per-LOD/transition diagnostic inventory for this candidate. Earlier baseline inventory is contextual only.
Two-entry caches are bounded per resident batch; no long production traversal/cancellation acceptance for the rejected implementation.
This narrow A/B/A rejection does not close the broader blocked rendering-baseline prerequisite.
